_doc: Small-indicator battery table. Single source of truth for regex tells (small strings that instantly signal a vuln class). Add a row when you learn one (engagement close-out, research ingest); keep patterns HIGH-PRECISION (a noisy tell trains the eye to ignore the battery). class/skill route the hit; note says what to read next.

tells.note: raw-HTML sink; read the render block + trace what feeds it
JS eval sink (client XSS); eval( in SERVER code = RCE, re-route
command-exec sink; trace the argument back to input
string-built SQL; read the query builder + param flow
deser sink; identify the gadget library + who controls the blob
server-side fetch; check whether the URL is user-influenced
XML parser; XXE unless entities disabled - check parser config
SSTI surface; check whether template source is user-controlled
redirect/file send on request input; traversal or open-redirect
hard key/JWT material; capture verbatim, test scope of use
hardcoded credential-ish assignment; verify it is not a placeholder
env-style secret name; read the value + where it is committed
HTML comment hint; read the whole comment block
stack trace in output; harvest paths/versions/SQL from it
version banner; fingerprint -> playbook.json targeted tests
debug mode flag; debug mode = stack traces + code exec surfaces
